description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyListViewController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and implements a public controller interface, setting up a Vue component and template for displaying a vacancy list view in the application.

classes.name: VacancyListViewController
classes.description: Controller for the vacancy list view, responsible for initializing a Vue component and selecting a template for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting the Vue component 'vacancy-list' and the 'no_header.html.twig' template.
